author: Arif Anil Dondurmaci

transitions.constraint: A changed payload revokes existing approval
Exact current payload hash; local operator declaration
Current sources, policy, payload and matching approval; one SQLite transaction
Verify and return existing artifact; no new event or effect

invariants.statement: An artifact exists if and only if the task is DONE
At most one artifact per task
invariants.verification: SQLite primary key; concurrent worker test

invariants.statement: A new effect requires exact-payload approval
invariants.verification: Execute guard; denial and positive-control test

invariants.statement: Source revisions require a fresh draft and approval

invariants.verification: Untrusted instruction fixture cannot execute without approval

invariants.statement: Receipt changes are detectable against the retained chain
invariants.verification: Hash and sequence validation; mutation test
invariants.limitation: No signature or external head anchor; a privileged writer can rewrite or truncate a consistent history

layers.mechanism: Deterministic state/policy guards, SQLite transactions and verification
Deterministic extractive planner; model worker absent because this is an offline fixture
Mechanical local/CI tests; independent semantic reviewer absent
Local operator review; cryptographic owner identity absent

decision: Commit artifact, terminal state and receipt in one local transaction
tradeoff: This supports a bounded local artifact sink, not remote effects
